_doc: plan-8675 C3: the phone windows whose content is PUBLIC. A visible window matching no rule makes the surface personal (fail-safe). title is a full-match regex over the window title from `dumpsys window windows`. Measured on android-35 (S0 AVD): NotificationShade is visible only while the shade is open, so it is deliberately absent here.
